notes.title: Martha - Version 2.1
notes.notes:
Major Update

1. Linux version is live
2. Standard PC/ Xbox Controller Support

Main updates

1.- Added flashlight as a new starting object for those who need it
2.- Save options settings, save brightness / mouse sensitivity
3. - Keypad UI added to Number Puzzles for controller support
4. - Screen Resolution for 1280 X 720 Added (some laptops had issues)
5. - Optimization to improve frame rate should see better performance
6. - Isabelle quit smoking and can now run for longer!
7. - Blood overlay has been improved to allow better vision

Settings updates

1. Brightness setting maximum increased
2. Controller information screen added
3. Add controls screen to menu so you can view controls before play
4. Add control info screen for play with controllers in the pause screen

Enemy Updates

1. Zombies now run at the player when they take significant damage
2. Winston slightly faster
3. Martha encounter % increased
4. Martha average dwell time increased

Minor updates & bugs fixed

1. Candle light ground floor slightly brighter
2. bullets picked up through the cabinet door bug is fixed
3. reduce ammo range for pickups meaning less ammo
4. Lighting enhanced - reduced darkness
5. Take the controls screen from Loading - nobody had time to read so controls information is on the main menu
6. increase cop zombie detect range so you can't avoid him
7. Gun bug with Ammo lost is fixed - no ammo thrown away
8. End battle glitch with switches fixed
9. Hail Mary condition now allows for emergency ammo if you have exhausted the house supply
10. Jack-o-lantern in house can be lit & Shed as well - because why not?
11. Some smaller issues text layers etc.
